info.title: Collections
info.author: Devlusaja
info.details:
Nintendo Switch homebrew that organizes your installed games into collections:

By number of players: automatic groups ("2 players", "4 players"…), each with every game that supports at least that many players, plus "1 player" for single-player-only games.
My groups: create, rename and delete your own groups and pick the games in each one.
Favorites: mark games with Y and find them all in one place.
Launch any game straight from the app. Touch screen supported. English and Spanish (Settings).

AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
